title: Uwunesheje hagati y'ibice bibiri
intro: Mu bitabo vy’ubuyobozi bw’Imana, umuntu umwe ahagaze ahantu hamwe nk’umutware w’inkomezi be n’umusuku yicisha bugufi wa Allah. Uwo muntu yaragiye mu bice vya kure cane vyo kw’isi, abona izuba rirashe ku bantu badasanzwe, rikarenga mu ruzi rwirabura rwuzuye umuco. Igitangaje kuruta ibindi vyose, uwo musuku yari yashinzwe kwubaka uruzitiro rudasanzwe rwo kurwanya ihanga ry’ububisha bwinshi. Woba ushobora kumenya uwo muntu w’inkuru z’imigani muri Korowani?
clues: Naciye mfata urugendo nja aho izuba rirasira n'aho rirenga .
Nashitse ku bantu batashobora gutahura ijambo na rimwe .
Nategetswe kwubaka uruzitiro runini cane nkoresheje ivyuma .
Napfutse ikibanza kiri hagati y'imisozi ibiri iteye igomwe nkoresheje ivyuma bishongeshejwe .
Sinari umumarayika canke umuhanuzi, ahubwo nari umusuku Allah yagiriye neza .

trial.label: Igikorwa gikomeye
options: Kubaka uruzitiro runini rw’icuma rwo kurwanya Yajuj na Majuj .
Kubaka ubwato mu gihe c'umwuzure munini .
trial.answer: Kubaka uruzitiro runini rw’icuma rwo kurwanya Yajuj na Majuj .

location.label: Ivyo gushinga
options: Igihugu ca Uzayiri kiri hagati y'inzuzi zibiri
Aho izuba rirasira n'isoko y'ivu ryirabura .
location.answer: Aho izuba rirasira n'isoko y'ivu ryirabura .

outcome.label: Umuhango w'Imana
options: Paradizo y'ibihe bidahera itangwa ubwo nyene
Intambamyi izogumaho gushika ku musi w'urubanza .
Ukwidegemvya mu rupfu ku bemera bose .
outcome.answer: Intambamyi izogumaho gushika ku musi w'urubanza .

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
